name: @askcal/mcp-server
description: MCP server for Cal — the AI mortgage platform at askcal.io. Exposes Cal's lender library, DPA programs, lender intel, ValueGuard valuations, and authoritative loan-limit / fee facts to any MCP-compatible client (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Continue, Goose, Zed). The first mortgage MCP server with a real lender data moat: 166 wholesale lenders, 1,400+ indexed documents, 250+ DPA programs, all 50 states.
author: Chris Black <chris@askcal.io> (https://askcal.io)
